  • Storytelling: estruturação de ideias conectando de forma lógica os temas, sintetizando e adaptando de acordo com o público-alvo se apoiando em técnicas, ferramentas e elementos visuais;
  • Elaboração de relatórios e análises diversas a partir de informações disponíveis no site do Banco Central e nas publicações de competidores;

  • Entendimento/mapeamento da situação atual, toda a análise e diagnóstico de gaps e condução do time para trazer proposições inovadoras;

  • Ser agente de transformação digital, viabilizando necessidade de negócio em soluções viáveis e escaláveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou afins;

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificações em projetos e processos (Lean SIxSigma, PMP, etc..);
  • Conhecimento em produtos e processos bancários.

title: Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Descrição da Empresa:

Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

title: Supplier Development Engineer (SDE)
description:
We are looking for a talented and proactive Supplier Development Engineer (SDE) to join our team in Latin America. If you have a passion for the renewable energy industry and experience in ensuring the highest quality standards, this is the opportunity for you!

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for the entire quality lifecycle of our suppliers in the region, from evaluation and qualification to continuous supervision and problem-solving.

Main Responsibilities:

• Supplier Evaluation & Development: Identify and evaluate new suppliers in cooperation with the Sourcing team to build a competitive and reliable supply chain.

• Quality Audits: Conduct quality system (ISO 9001), process, and product audits to ensure new suppliers and materials meet our stringent requirements.

• Product Approval (PPAP): Manage the sample approval process for new products and complete the material PPAP process, signing off on quality agreements with the R&D department.

• Production Supervision: Oversee supplier production, including incoming materials, manufacturing processes, warehousing, and shipment, and prepare daily supervision and outgoing reports.

• Non-Conformance Management: Promptly address and resolve quality issues from suppliers, ensuring that corrective actions are implemented effectively and tracked until closure.

• Regional Support: Assist in handling quality issues for inventory in Latin America (e.g., packaging, rust, material shortages) and manage project quality complaints by investigating root causes and following up on solutions.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain clear communication with Procurement, Logistics, and Project Management departments.

Job Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering. A Master’s degree is preferred.

• 3+ years of work experience, preferably in the PV, new energy, or a related industry.

• Proficient in ISO 9001 quality systems, supplier management, and project quality management.

• Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) is required. Basic communication skills in Chinese are a plus.

• Knowledge of industry standards and experience with solar plants.

• Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the Latin America region.

• Target-oriented mindset, self-motivation, and excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

description:
This is a dynamic role that involves navigating through various responsibilities within the Finance department. The ideal candidate should be able to cover for employees during vacation periods and maternity leave, and eventually, by mid-next year, assume a Finance Analyst role responsible for Sales Invoices and Accounts Payable.

We are looking for someone willing to lead and execute a project to automate our accounts payable process by implementing CNAB file usage (the system already supports this functionality).   • Excel skills.

  • Ter contribuído com algum projeto open source.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável por conduzir os processos da cadeia de compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento de equipe e analise de mercado. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro.

Responsável pela movimentação de peças nos diferentes estoque (inclusive entre lojas da mesma marca), garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal.

Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no tange os KPIs da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.

OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos técnicos sólidos em Excel (ser avançado é mandatório);
  • Inglês avançado é mandatório;
  • Formação: Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia, e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos:
  • Conhecimentos de consumidor e tendências de comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos elementares em moda e mercado de luxo;

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências;
  • Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos;
  • Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget;
  • Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), tanto quanti quanto qualitativamente, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (KPI); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade das ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto;
  • Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças;
  • Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas;
  • Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, as principais clientes precisa conhecer pessoalmente, ter relacionamento);
  • Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos);
  • Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento;
  • Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada, dos relatórios e calls com as marcas, garantindo repasse de informação sobre nosso negocio;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e dinâmico com altas demandas;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar internacionalmente para os markets das marcas - frequência de 1x por semestre.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
OPTIVIQ Inc. with roots in the Pulp & Paper Industry for nearly 40 years, holding the exclusive global license for the distribution and support of OptiVision™, a leading software solution for managing complex manufacturing processes. Owned by Constellation Software Inc., a global leader in vertical market software, we offer a unique environment that combines the flexibility of a medium-sized company with the opportunities and resources of a 50,000+ employee organization.

Division Link:

Job Description

The OptiVision™ Account Manager plays a critical role in managing and nurturing relationships with key customers. This role is responsible for being the primary point of contact for customer communication of technical topics, working with multiple accounts, and ensuring that customer needs are met by overseeing ticket management, release testing, and handling the estimation of enhancements process. The Account Manager will collaborate closely with the Customer Experience Manager, other Account Managers and internal teams to resolve customer issues in a timely manner and drive customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Primary Customer Communication:

Serve as the key point of contact for assigned customers, maintaining regular communication and building strong relationships.

Product Knowledge:

Continue to develop and maintain a deep understanding of OPTIVIQ’s software solutions, including OptiVision™. Stay current with new product releases, features, and updates to provide accurate information and guidance to customers.

Customer Business Process Knowledge:

Continuously gain knowledge of the customer’s business processes and how they intersect with OptiVision™ and other OPTIVIQ software solutions. Understand customer-specific workflows and requirements.

Ticket Management:

Oversee and manage customer tickets, ensuring timely responses and resolutions. Collaborate with support teams to escalate issues when necessary and track progress.

Release Testing (for Customers):

Coordinate and manage the testing of new releases for customers, ensuring that updates or new features function correctly in customer environments.

Enhancement Estimate Process:

Upon request from customers, create Enhancement Tickets, Statements of Work, Estimation of Efforts and Documents of Understanding, working closely with the Customer Experience Manager for the generation of quotes and proposals. Liaise with internal departments to track and fulfill customer requests.

Customer/Product Issue Resolution:

Identify and resolve customer and product-related issues. Serve as a problem-solving resource for customers and coordinate solutions with other departments.

Collaboration with Account Managers:

Work closely with other Account Managers to share knowledge, insights, and best practices. Collaborate on cross-functional customer projects and initiatives.

Timecard Maintenance:

Ensure proper timecard management for customer-related activities, ensuring accurate time tracking for billing and project purposes.

Knowledge of Tools and Reporting:

Develop expertise in the tools and reporting systems used by OPTIVIQ to manage customer accounts, monitor service delivery, and report on customer metrics.

Regular Customer Meetings:

Organize and participate in regular customer meetings to discuss ongoing projects, updates, and any outstanding issues. Maintain a proactive approach to customer engagement.

Manages Multiple Customers:

Successfully manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously, ensuring that each customer receives a high level of service and attention.

Required Skills & Experience

Product Knowledge:

  • Experience in using, configuring, supporting and maintaining OptiVision™
  • Experience in the Pulp and Paper industry

Customer Relationship Management:

  • Proven experience managing key accounts in a B2B environment, preferably within a software or technology company.

Business Process Understanding:

  • Ability to understand complex customer business processes and how they relate to the implementation and use of OptiVision™.

Issue Resolution

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying root causes and delivering effective solutions.

Communication Skills:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Portuguese and English – Advanced Level

Ability to Travel Internationally

Organizational Skills:

Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

Technical Aptitude:

Experience with CRM systems, service ticketing tools, and reporting systems.

Team Collaboration:

Ability to work well in cross-functional teams and share knowledge with peers.

Desired Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.

A minimum of 5 years in a customer-facing role with account management experience.

Familiarity with SQL or other database querying skills is a plus.

Essential Functions

For up to 8 hours per day you must be able to fully utilize standard computer equipment, required programs, phone, and office equipment. You must be able to lift and carry a laptop computer.

  • Desenvolver integrações e processamentos de dados utilizando Pyspark e Spark. Orquestrar workflows de dados complexos com Apache Airflow. Criar, manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, Google Cloud Build, etc.).

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Description

Together with Samsung LATAM Countries, the role will be responsible for the development, sales and overall performance of the main D2C sales programs and new business projects, leading the following pillars/strategic areas:

  • Sales Operations: Promote eStore capabilities and coordinate key initiatives along with internal platform/product teams or external partners, aiming to achieve D2C main targets.
  • D2C Sell-out Platforms Management: Strengthen LATAM D2C exclusive programs (such as: Trade-in, Co-Branded Card, Extended Warranty, Installation Service), enabling the sales growth and targets achievement.
  • New Business Projects: Define innovative programs based on sell-out platforms such as subscription models and value-added services and draw the commercial strategies to execute and grow them.
  • CRP: Customer Retention Program ambassador in LATAM D2C, engaging all subsidiary in the company’s strategy and promoting the alignment and projects execution with CS and related stakeholders.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Define, track, report and engage LATAM Countries to implement the regional/global Sell-out enablers strategy, and ensure the main KPIs achievement.
  • Define the sell-out programs sales strategy by working with the business areas to implement the promotional and forecast plan.
  • Ensure the sell-out programs’ financial sustainability while balancing an attractive promotional agenda with business profitability.
  • Support in marketing / UX strategies for the sell-out enablers launch and enhancement, ensuring the correct communication and display of programs for brand consumers.
  • Act as a PMO of regional projects that focus on accelerating D2C performance.
  • Together with Samsung subsidiaries in LATAM, act in the management of partnerships that make up the digital online channel ecosystem.
  • Prospect regional partnerships and co-lead the deployment of those along with the subsidiaries.
  • In conjunction with the IT team, manage the D2C sell-out projects roadmap, responding by the business assessment, development, execution, GTM and usability of the tools.
  • Manage the continuous improvement agenda of the D2C programs, focusing on user experience and increasing of conversion.
  • Integration with CS Team and related areas to promote CRP (Customer Retention Program) agenda in D2C LATAM, engaging eStore Business and Commercial teams to implement the regional strategy.
  • Executive report on sell-out programs strategies and business results.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Administration, Business Administration, or related areas.
  • Experience in Online sales management and digital environment.
  • Experience in commercial department or sales planning.
  • Management/operation of e-commerce platforms.
  • Strong skills in communication and project management.
  • Master presentation and report skills, structured by deep data analysis.
  • Ease in dealing with complex database in Excel.
  • Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus).

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth. Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our international Data Solutions & Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, scaling, and maintenance of the code that powers our production systems. You will work autonomously, providing technical direction and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple projects. You will proactively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product and Data Science, to drive strategic initiatives. With significant freedom to innovate, you will play a pivotal role in world-class research, shaping the next generation of Cint products and mentoring less experienced engineers. Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on professional backend software development experience, with a significant portion in a leadership or principal role.

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Proficient programming skills in Python or Java and comfortable maintaining code in both languages, with a strong emphasis on architectural design and code quality.

  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, advanced testing frameworks, and deployment strategies.

  • Extensive experience with complex API integration, design, and best practices, including defining API standards.

  • Expertise in dealing with system complexity, distributed systems, and large-scale architectural challenges.

  • Exceptional sense of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.

  • Consistently questions the status quo and brings innovative, impactful solutions to engineering and product needs, driving significant technical advancements.

  • Strong ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

  • Enjoys working as part of a team, actively mentoring and guiding other engineers, and providing constructive feedback to foster growth.

  • Comfortable with making critical decisions based on comprehensive data analysis and industry best practices.

  • Outstanding communication skills to guide and facilitate complex cross-functional collaboration and present technical strategies to diverse audiences.

  • Extensive background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar, with experience in designing and optimizing data pipelines.

  • Deep familiarity with observability strategies, including advanced monitoring, logging, and tracing.

  • Extensive experience with AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced SQL, including database design and performance tuning.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.

Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:

A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: Netsuite consultant
description:
Job Title: NetSuite Consultant

Location: Brazil (Hybrid / Remote options considered)

Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced NetSuite Consultant to join our growing team in Brazil. This role will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and optimising NetSuite ERP solutions, while acting as a trusted advisor to our business stakeholders. You will play a critical part in enabling process improvements, supporting ongoing enhancements, and ensuring the business leverages NetSuite to its fullest potential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support NetSuite ERP implementations across finance, supply chain, and operations modules.
  • Gather, document, and analyse business requirements, translating them into effective NetSuite solutions.
  • Configure NetSuite modules, workflows, dashboards, and reports.
  • Provide subject matter expertise across Finance, Procurement, Inventory, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Reporting .
  • Partner with stakeholders to optimise business processes and align them with system capabilities.
  • Deliver training and support for end users, ensuring knowledge transfer and adoption.
  • Collaborate with technical teams on integrations, customisations, and system upgrades.
  • Troubleshoot issues, resolve defects, and manage change requests.
  • Stay updated on NetSuite best practices, new releases, and emerging functionality.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience as a NetSuite Consultant / Functional Specialist .
  • Hands-on expertise in at least two of the following modules: Financials, Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Projects, CRM .
  • Strong understanding of ERP business processes and workflows.
  • Ability to configure NetSuite (workflows, SuiteFlow, saved searches, dashboards, reports).
  • Experience in full-cycle NetSuite ERP implementations highly desirable.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with both business and technical teams.
  • Professional-level English (spoken and written). Portuguese or Spanish is a plus.

Personal Attributes

  • Problem-solver with strong analytical skills.
  • Business-focused, with the ability to challenge and improve processes.
  • Strong communicator, able to engage with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Self-motivated and proactive with a continuous improvement mindset.

What’s on Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Career growth and professional development in a global environment.
  • Exposure to a wide range of NetSuite projects and business processes.
  • Flexible working model (Brazil-based, hybrid/remote options available).
